raised: Option A's labels are split over two lines under the columns, so the reader keeps looking from the number at the top to the word at the bottom
The 'מומלץ' (recommended) badge doesn't say who recommends it or why
The page never shows the fund and a securities account side by side; the subtitle even says that comparison was removed
The small 'before' picture is too tiny to read easily
'אפשר לגרור את השנים' is unclear (drag what?)
'חלקים שמרחפים' (floating parts) means nothing to the reader
Fund codes, company names and 'מבין 14 שנאספו' in the assumptions paragraph read as meaningless code numbers
'הגובה נמתח בכל שנה' is confusing: what is the reader supposed to compare from year to year?
The dark brown and dark grey blocks under the bright colours are unclear
In the year-6 chart, a dark green box above 'המס לקח 0 ₪' makes the reader doubt the zero tax

The fee-range sentence about the 19 tracks never states its plain conclusion
Jargon ('מסלול מדד', 'S&P500', 'מחקה') isn't explained
Missing: what happens to the employer's 900 ₪ if the reader doesn't join
Missing: anything about age or retirement, such as taking money out tax-free before year 6
Missing: whether there is a ceiling on how much salary counts
The page doesn't say clearly that the amounts are in today's money
Would drop one of the two chart options (Option A)
